correctness.rationale: For every positive sampling vector the two moment formulas follow from inclusion-exclusion and tail sums. With two common-species abundances parameterized by t=bc, exact differentiation at the symmetric locus gives V_t=-32Q(a)/(1-a²)^4. The strictly increasing quintic Q has one root in (0,1/3). Its sign gives the local extrema for all noncritical a. At the root the exact quartic coefficient 128R(a)/(1-a²)^6 is positive by rational interval bounds. A direct conditional rare/nonrare coupling proves strict full-detection stochastic improvement for all n≥3. A two-species closed form rules out variance-increasing balancing at smaller species counts. Standalone verify.py independently cross-checks exact finite-state moments and symbolic identities.

originality.rationale: Long (2026), §7.6 explicitly states the qualitative failure of pairwise variance smoothing for ordinary coupon collection, and Yu (2017) and Long (2026) prove global uniform variance minimality. Those existing conclusions are excluded from the novelty claim. The new mathematical statement is the exact natural rare-abundance boundary a*=0.147902... defined by a unique quintic root, with a sign-changing local curvature, positive fourth-order degenerate case, and sharp three-species ecological interpretation. Anceaume (2014) supplies moment/distribution formulae; Zoroa et al. (2016) supplies stochastic ordering in ecological sampling. Neither the global radial minimum nor the qualitative existence of counterexamples implies the local Hessian sign along fixed-rare-frequency balancing, and no located statement gives this boundary. Unexamined literature remains a priority risk.

value.rationale: The fixed-rare-proportion, equal-common-species locus is a canonical ecological survey design section, not an arbitrary isolated numerical slice. Its precise rare-abundance threshold changes the direction of uncertainty under balancing although the completion-time distribution improves at every sample horizon; the degeneracy at threshold and sharp minimal richness are meaningful exact boundaries. Qualitative pairwise-smoothing failure is prior and not claimed; the exact phase diagram provides motivated additional information beyond general variance minimization.
